title: Albert Stein's deathbed call to Sheehan

tellings.quote: Albert Stein was this guy's name uh he called me on his deathbed uh he was dying up in in northern Minnesota

plain: A man named Albert Stein, dying in a hospice in northern Minnesota, called the lawyer Dan Sheehan from his deathbed. Sheehan tells Michels it happened to him: "he called me on his deathbed, he was dying up in northern Minnesota." What Stein wanted to get off his chest is not given in the telling, but a deathbed call is the kind of last confession that makes people take a story seriously.
